notes.title: Morningtide Motel Hotfix 5
notes.content:
Thank you to all those who have reported bugs so far, especially the room service softlock. With this hotfix, we believe to have resolved that bug, at long last!

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where players would get stuck in room service events and were unable to return to the lobby
[/list]

We really value any additional bug reports and feedback, If you encounter any issues, you can email as at [url=mailto:dev@slandercast.studio]dev@slandercast.studio[/url]].

notes.title: Morningtide Motel Hotfix 4 (1/19/2025)
notes.content:
Thanks again for playing Morningtide Motel, and thank you to all those who have reported bugs so far. Here's a hotfix for some of those bugs:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where players would get stuck talking to Sarge on Day 19
[*] Fixed a bug where Tyree would erroneously perform a song for you
[*] Fixed a bug where Charlie would not leave the motel
[*] Fixed a bug where you could not reject Juno when your motel is full
[/list]

We are continuing to investigate issues with players getting stuck in room service interactions. If you encountered this bug, please file a bug report with your save file so we can learn more about this issue. And once again, if your save file is soft-locked and you would like help fixing it, please email us at dev@slandercast.studio and we are glad to help you out!

We really value any additional bug reports and feedback, If you encounter any issues, you can email as at [url=mailto:dev@slandercast.studio]dev@slandercast.studio[/url] or fill out [url=https://forms.gle/itQCQ74P5xoRi74D8]our bug report form[/url].

Fixed a bug where Tyree would erroneously perform a song for you
Fixed a bug where Charlie would not leave the motel
Fixed a bug where you could not reject Juno when your motel is full

notes.title: Morningtide Motel Hotfix 1 (12/30/2024)
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone for playing Morningtide Motel! We hope you're enjoying the game so far. We've released a quick hotfix for some issues players were reporting:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where hotel guests did not properly trigger on Day 14
[*] Fixed a bug where Juno did not say anything on Night 14
[/list]

We really value any additional bug reports and feedback, If you encounter any issues, you can email as at [url=mailto:dev@slandercast.studio]dev@slandercast.studio[/url] or fill out [url=https://forms.gle/itQCQ74P5xoRi74D8][our bug report form [link]][/url].
